'''2009 Bespin Regionals Ryan Ritter DS Knowledge And Defense (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Ritter]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Knowledge And Defense (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)|OVS15-52-Knowledge_And_Defense-remaster.webp|label=Knowledge And Defense (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Bad Horse
* '''Username:''' CoolioZC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
